sentence: Never get sherminated from a twitchen you helped stock.

wombos.definition: A kitchen shared with or belonging to your twin or twin-coded roommate. The twin version of a kitchen — where twin-coded cooking, crashing out, and loreaining happens.
To be fired in a sudden, shocking, and frankly cinematic way. Not just terminated — shockingly terminated. Used as a verb: 'the manager quickly sherminated her.'
